hooks.command: for d in frontend backend desktop; do if [ -d "$d/node_modules" ]; then echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') $PWD: $d/node_modules 已存在，跳过" >> /tmp/claude-wt-setup.log; else echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') $PWD: $d 缺 node_modules，npm ci 开始" >> /tmp/claude-wt-setup.log; (cd "$d" && npm ci) >> /tmp/claude-wt-setup.log 2>&1; fi; done; true
